macros.name: bXBlocrL
macros.doc: The syntax is \bXBlocrL[⟨distance⟩]{hNamei}{hContentsi}{hPrevious Nodei}. The block created by this command will be placed ⟨distance⟩ (the default is 2) units to the left of hPrevious Nodei and then draws the connecting link between hPrevious Nodei and the new block.

macros.name: bXLabelStyleDefault
macros.doc: To re-establish the label style, use \bXLabelStyleDefault.

macros.name: bXLineStyle
macros.doc: To change the default line style, \bXLineStyle takes one argument which is added to the default line description by tikz.

macros.name: bXLink
macros.doc: The normal macro is \bXLink which takes 3 arguments. It draws straight lines between the right edge of the previous node and the left edge of the next node.

macros.name: bXLinkName
macros.doc: This macro adds a label to the output of a diagram at the end like the optional argument does on the input of the diagram.

macros.name: bXLinktyx
macros.doc: \bXLinktyx{hPrevious Nodei}{hNext Nodei} draws a link from the top, center of hPrevious Nodei to the closest horizontal connecting node on hNext Nodei via a right-angle turn.

macros.name: bXLinkxy
macros.doc: The command \bXLinkxy uses the same arguments. It creates a line which exits from the east side of hPrevious Nodei, makes a right angle and tries to connect to the north or south side of hNext Nodei.

macros.name: bXStyleBloc
macros.doc: To change the default, use \bXStyleBloc{hStyle listi}. hStyle listi is a comma separated list of tikz keywords to change the display of the block.

macros.name: bXStyleBlocDefault
macros.doc: The default block style is stored in \bXStyleBlocDefault and can be used to restore the default settings if they are changed.

macros.name: bXStylePotato
macros.doc: To change the default, the \bXStylePotato command will take an argument and add it to the current block style definition.

macros.name: bXStylePotatoDefault
macros.doc: To re-establish the potato block style, use \bXStylePotatoDefault.

macros.name: bXStyleSumDefault
